% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): user styles defined with
% \pgfplotsset and used in axis and plot options, every axis plot.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\pgfplotsset{
  myaxis/.style={width=8cm, height=5cm, grid=major},
  myplot/.style={red, thick, mark=square*},
  every axis plot/.append style={line width=1pt},
}
\begin{axis}[myaxis]
\addplot[myplot] coordinates {(0,2) (1,3) (2,2.5) (3,4)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,1) (1,1.5) (2,1) (3,2)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
